title: 第4章 第一案：518儿童被拐案（4）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“李队，我联系了车主，车主说他的车一直停在地下车库没动过。

还提供了监控！

我们被耍了！”

东维神情愤恨，牙齿磨得咯吱作响。

念念骄傲挺胸，“现在可以去赵家村了吧？”

东维冷哼，“就算人贩子没有藏在别墅，那也不能证明你说的就是对的！

万一我们去了赵家村，人贩子不在怎么办？

耽误时间，导致孩子们受害，谁能担责？”

念念气鼓着一张小脸，对着东维脚尖，恶狠狠的踩！

可东维今天穿的是一双硬包头皮鞋。

念念一脚踩下去，跟挠痒痒差不多。

反倒自己没站稳，脚还崴了一下！

眼泪瞬间涌上眼眶。

东维连忙后撤！

“这可不怪我啊！是你自己作！”

任曼妮皱眉，将念念护在身后，刚想说话，就被李安国用身形挡住。

“行了！所有人听令。

带好装备，即刻出发，赵家村！”

念念眼睛一亮，连忙擦干眼泪跟上。

她要亲眼看着那群人贩子被抓！

再找他们老大问问，当年有没有拐卖过她，她爸爸妈妈是谁！

李安国刚扣好安全带。

一个软糯糯的小人儿就钻进了他怀中。

“出发！”

奶萌音起，警员一脚油门就冲了出去！

不过跑了不到十米。

又一脚刹车急停！

念念被李安国提溜着后领，从车上扔下。

警车‘呜’的一声跑远。

(ﾒ｀ﾛ´)/

“是我帮你们找到坏蛋的！啊！！”

念念气到跳脚。

看着警车离去的背影，宛若看到自己的奖金在不断跑远。

她扭身跑回警局。

拉着任曼妮的手就要她带自己去。

任曼妮无奈。

“念念，现在已经很晚了，姐姐带你去睡觉好不好？

等你睡醒，李队他们就回来了。”

念念眼神幽怨，“不可能，没有念念，他们绝对不可能找得到人贩！”

任曼妮轻笑，并没有将念念的话放在心上。

毕竟念念再能干，抓人贩的活也是他们警察该干的。

今天跟着李队出去的，哪一个不是警局里干了几十年的老警员。

这种案子，小case！

李安国也是这种想法。

况且办案呢！

带个小孩算怎么回事？

Page (1/3)

“Captain Li, I contacted the car owner, who said that his car had been parked in the underground garage and had not been moved.

Monitoring is also provided!

We've been fooled!"

Dong Wei looked angry, his teeth grinding loudly.

Niannian puffed up her chest proudly, "Can we go to Zhaojiacun now?"

Dong Wei snorted coldly, "Even if the trafficker is not hiding in the villa, that doesn't prove that what you said is right!

What if we go to Zhaojia Village and the traffickers are not there?

Who can take responsibility for wasting time and causing harm to the children?"

Nian Nian puffed up her little face angrily, stepped on Dong Wei's toes fiercely!

But Dongwei was wearing a pair of hard-covered leather shoes today.

Nian Nian stepped on it, which was almost like scratching an itch.

On the contrary, I couldn't stand firm and my feet sprained a bit!

Tears instantly welled up in his eyes.

Dongwei quickly retreated!

"It's not my fault! You did it yourself!"

Ren Manni frowned and protected Nian Nian behind her. Just as she was about to speak, Li Anguo blocked her with his body.

"Okay! Everyone obeys the order.

Bring your equipment and set off immediately to Zhaojiacun!"

Nian Nian's eyes lit up, and she quickly wiped away her tears and followed.

She wanted to see those traffickers caught with her own eyes!

Then ask their boss if she was kidnapped and trafficked back then, and who her parents are!

Li Anguo just fastened his seat belt.

A soft and waxy little person got into his arms.

"Let's go!"

As the cute voice sounded, the police officer stepped on the accelerator and rushed out!

But he ran less than ten meters.

Another sudden stop with the brakes!

Niannian was carried by Li Anguo's collar and thrown from the car.

The police car roared and ran away.

(ﾒ｀ﾛ´)/

"I helped you find the bad guy! Ah!!"

Nian Nian was so angry that she jumped to the point of jumping.

Watching the police car leave, it was as if he could see his bonus running away.

She turned and ran back to the police station.

He took Ren Manni's hand and asked her to take him there.

Ren Manni was helpless.

"Niannian, it's very late now, can my sister take you to bed?

When you wake up, Captain Li and the others will be back."

Nian Nian's eyes were filled with resentment, "It's impossible. Without Nian Nian, they would never be able to find the human traffickers!"

Ren Manni chuckled and didn't take Nian Nian's words to heart.

After all, no matter how talented Nian Nian is, the job of catching human traffickers is what the police should do.

Everyone who followed Team Li out today was not a veteran police officer who had worked in the police station for decades.

This kind of case is a small case!

Li Anguo also thinks this way.

Not to mention handling the case!

What's the point of raising a child?
